title: Branching: edit, resend, regenerate
desc: Edit any of your messages and resend, or regenerate a reply: the transcript forks behind a version pager that swaps real DOM tails, so nested forks, tool rows, and feedback survive in each version. Thumbs recorded per reply. Nothing destroyed.
why: A conversation is a tree pretending to be a line. Edit-and-resend without losing the original is how every major chat earns trust in exploration.
